roll-name.purpose: Project names in the project list.

title.purpose: h3 and chapter titles (Barlow Semi Condensed 700).

data.purpose: Frame numbers, counters, chapter numbers, paths (Martian Mono, tabular).

shadows.name: selection
shadows.purpose: Selected cell; status ring goes inside, selection ring outside (3px + 6px).

shadows.name: search-focus
shadows.purpose: Search field in the yellow bar.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared spring-out curve for all movement.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Yellow call to action; hover turns red.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font: 700 15px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; background: #ffb300; color: #111; border: 2px solid #ffb300; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d7261e; border-color: #d7261e; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4f1e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font: 700 15px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; background: transparent; color: #f4f1e8; border: 2px solid #f4f1e8; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f4f1e8; color: #121212; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb300; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Hairline field with yellow focus halo.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; background: #0b0b0b; color: #f4f1e8; border: 1px solid #2e2e2e; border-radius: 3px; font: 500 16px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #a39e92; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #ffb300; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,179,0,.35); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Black track with a yellow selected segment (radiogroup).
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; background: #111; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-seg-b { height: 34px; padding: 0 11px; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; color: #e8dcc0; font: 600 14px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-b.on { background: #ffb300; color: #111; } .ds-seg-b:not(.on):hover { color: #fff; } .ds-seg-b:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb300; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: role=switch toggle; knob turns yellow when on.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; background: none; border: 0; padding: 4px 0; color: #f4f1e8; font: 600 14px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-track { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 22px; border-radius: 11px; background: #0b0b0b; border: 2px solid #ffb300; } .ds-switch-track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffb300; transform: translateX(16px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb300; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chapter Row
components.description: Sidebar chapter roll; active row has a yellow number chip.
components.css: .ds-ch { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 8px; background: #1b1b1b; border-radius: 3px; color: #f4f1e8; } .ds-ch-no { font: 600 11px 'Martian Mono', monospace; padding: 3px 0; text-align: center; background: #ffb300; color: #111; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-ch-title { font: 700 17px/1.15 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; } .ds-ch-n { font: 600 13px 'Martian Mono', monospace; color: #ff7a1a; }

components.name: Photo Cell with Edge Caption
components.description: Neutral frame over a black edge-print strip; kept state shown as a green ring.
components.css: .ds-cell { width: 190px; background: #303030; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #35b36b; } .ds-frame { aspect-ratio: 3/2; background: #303030; } .ds-edge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 6px 8px; background: #0b0b0b; color: #ff7a1a; font: 400 12px 'Martian Mono', monospace; } .ds-dx { width: 7px; height: 9px; background: #ff7a1a; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 50%, 0 100%); } .ds-fno { font-weight: 600; } .ds-fname { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: #8c7a68; }

components.name: Toast
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; background: #111; color: #f4f1e8; border: 1px solid #3a3a3a; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.55); font: 500 16px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Every shoot is a roll of film. The chrome is film-box packaging: a yellow top bar over a red rule, black edge-print strips under each frame, and orange mono frame numbers. The photos sit on a neutral grey surround that no theme color touches. Dark by default, with a light theme (cream ground, same yellow bar, same grey surround). Departures from the contract: keep is green; the chapter rail is a bordered sidebar card; counters sit in the action strip; captions read <n>A with a decorative constant A.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow bar (64px) with a 6px red bottom rule, yellow in both themes.
Photos on a neutral grey surround; no hue near a photo.
Black edge-print captions with orange Martian Mono frame numbers.
Authored custom controls with real roles; keyboard-operable.
One spring easing; prefers-reduced-motion collapses all motion.

rules.name: The Neutral Surround Rule
rules.body: Nothing but neutral grey touches a photo's edge. Status rings hug the cell; the grid background never takes theme color.

rules.name: The Keep Is Green Rule
rules.body: Green means keep. Yellow means pick, star, group, or active. Red means reject or group badge. Off-white ring means selection.

rules.name: The Bar Stays Yellow Rule
rules.body: The top bar is film-yellow with on-yellow ink and a red rule in both themes; focus rings inside it are #111.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Display face for names only, condensed sans for everything operable, mono for anything numeric or edge-printed.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers that change use mono with tabular figures so digits do not shift.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Chosen Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; lift is reserved for the selected frame and transient toasts.

dos: Do keep the bar yellow with a 6px red rule and on-yellow ink in both themes.
Do put every frame number and counter in Martian Mono with tabular figures; frame captions read <n>A.
Do keep photo surround neutral grey in both themes.
Do show keep as green, reject as red, selection as an off-white (dark) or near-black (light) ring.
Do build new controls as authored elements with real roles, aria-* state, and a visible :focus-visible ring (2px, offset 2px).
Do use authored inline SVG icons in the existing stroke style.
Do route new animation through the shared easing and let the global reduced-motion rule neutralise it.
donts: Don't use browser-native selects, checkboxes, range inputs or dialogs.
Don't tint the grid, thumbnails or lightbox image area with theme color.
Don't treat the A in 14A as meaningful data; it is edge-print decoration.
Don't use yellow for keep or green for pick; roles are fixed.
Don't set body copy in Archivo Black or use text glyphs as icons.
